q: How do I estimate the emissions from the office paper we buy?
title: Office paper emissions per ream
short: Convert reams to weight, then apply a paper factor. A ream of 500 A4 sheets at 80 gsm weighs about 2.5 kg. Multiply total kilograms by a factor for virgin or recycled paper from a published table. It is Scope 3 Category 1 and usually small.

p: One A4 sheet is 0.0624 square metres. At 80 gsm that is about 5 g, so 500 sheets weigh about 2.5 kg.
Use a paper factor per tonne from a published set such as the UK government conversion factors, and pick recycled where your invoice says so.

example.title: A year of paper
lines: 400 reams x 2.5 kg = 1,000 kg of paper
1 tonne x the paper factor from your chosen table
